name: Combobox
import: import { Combobox, ComboboxInput, ComboboxContent, ComboboxList, ComboboxItem, ComboboxEmpty } from "@/components/ui/combobox"
description: A searchable select — type to filter a large list of options.

Combobox.description: The root. Give it `items`; it filters them by the input text.

items.description: All options. Filtered automatically as the user types.

value.description: Controlled selected value. Use with onValueChange.

ComboboxItem.description: One option, rendered by the ComboboxList render function.

forbidden: Do not use a Combobox for a short list (≤ ~7); a Select is simpler and needs no typing.
Always include ComboboxEmpty so an empty search isn't a blank void.
Give the input a placeholder and an accessible name (a Label).
Trigger/popup/item colors come from tokens; don't restyle via className.
example:
<Combobox items={frameworks}>
  <ComboboxInput placeholder="Search framework…" />
  <ComboboxContent>
    <ComboboxEmpty>No framework found.</ComboboxEmpty>
    <ComboboxList>
      {(item) => (
        <ComboboxItem key={item} value={item}>{item}</ComboboxItem>
      )}
    </ComboboxList>
  </ComboboxContent>
</Combobox>

responsive.note: Interactive targets should remain at least 44px. Layouts should fit parent width without horizontal overflow on mobile.
